You are auditing this session's work in the Archon Horizon workspace at /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon, project Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild (at MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild). Lane: ajcr-p3, run 0089 round 3.

THE FILE UNDER AUDIT: AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/DivisorFamilyAffAbel.lean (new this session). It reached HEAD across three commits: eb72ffe94c, 9f57a2b326, and (via another lane's integrate sweep) c2e6be0573. It is rooted in AlgebraicJacobian.lean.

MY CLAIMS, which I want attacked rather than confirmed:

(1) STRUCTURAL/CENSUS CLAIM. Before this file, the widened R2 carrier `DivFamZarAff` (which human protection I-0492 mandates) had a Picard CLASS map (`DivFamZarAff.picClass`) and its naturalities, plus a functor `divFunctorAff` and a comparison `divFunctorToAff` -- but ZERO declarations carrying it to `PicEtAff` / `picEt` / `relPic` / `pic0`. I claim the entire Abel layer (abelDivPlus, abelDivAff, abelDiv, abelDivTrans, chartValue, DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass) was stated at the CHART-TYPED `DivFamZar` only. VERIFY THIS CENSUS INDEPENDENTLY, and note that a case-sensitive grep for a Lean predicate misses producers in suffix position (recorded lesson I-1005) -- if my census is wrong in the direction that matters (i.e. a widened-to-Picard map already existed), that is the most valuable thing you can find, because it would make my file a re-derivation.

(2) IMPORTANCE CLAIM. I claim this gap is why antecedent 3 of `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` (Picard/Pic0SigmaSheaf.lean:161) -- namely `rep : (divFunctor C pi n).RepresentableBy D` -- cannot be satisfied on the mandated carrier: `abelSigmaChart` (Pic0AtlasFromDivRep.lean:205) consumes a representation of the CHART-TYPED divFunctor, while I-0492 mandates the widened one, and `isCertified_affine_and_not_isCertified_chart` (DivisorFamilyAffStrict.lean) puts a straddling divisor on the widened side out of chart-typed reach. Is that reasoning sound, or am I overstating? In particular: does anything already bridge widened representability to chart-typed representability, or make the distinction irrelevant?

(3) THE HONESTY OF THE RESIDUE. `chartValueAff_mem_pic0Subgroup` carries an explicit hypothesis `hdegAff` (the widened degree ledger: the widened Abel value of a degree-n class has degree n at every field point). I claim (a) this is a GENUINE obligation, because the chart-typed ledger `degAt_abelDiv` runs through `DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass` whose degree half `DivisorAdaptation.deg_presentationDivisor_eq_finrank_glued` consumes `relCover_sup` + `cover0`/`cover1`, the pinned-pair covering R2 deletes; and (b) that `hdegAff` is INHABITED, witnessed by my `degAt_abelDivAff'_toAff` at widened sections coming from chart-typed ones. ATTACK BOTH. Is (a) real or did I miss a widened degree route that already exists? Is (b) an honest non-vacuity witness, or is it the `P -> P` / "projecting the hypothesis you assumed" pattern the round's protection I-0838 forbids? Also: is `hdegAff` stated in a form that mentions its objects (the anti-`HasDivFunctor` rule), or is it a disguised vacuity?

(4) NON-VACUITY / DEGENERACY. Check whether any of the 10 declarations is vacuous or degenerate: e.g. is `abelDivAff'` trivial, does anything collapse at n = 0 or at an empty test, is `abelDivAffPlus_toAff` saying something or is it `rfl` on both sides in a way that makes the "extension not a fork" claim empty?

(5) WHAT I MIGHT HAVE OVERCLAIMED IN PROSE. Read the module docstring and every declaration docstring as claims to be checked. This project's audit history (99 of 101 representability claims refuted) is heavy on headers that overstate. I explicitly say NO certificate is produced, NO gate cleared, and rep stays undischarged -- check that the file does not contradict that anywhere, and that no docstring cites a declaration outside the file's import closure (I ran a #check probe over 27 cited names and it passed after I added two imports; re-verify independently if cheap).

METHOD NOTES. Before believing any LSP probe, ensure oleans are current -- `lake build AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffAbel` from the project root (it succeeded at 8958 jobs for me). `lean_multi_attempt` reports every snippet as closing the goal when imports are stale. Use a deliberate sorried CONTROL in any axiom probe. Prefer `horizon search "<name>"` (declaration index over both projects and mathlib) over grep for existence questions -- invoke as "$HORIZON_BIN" search.

Report: which claims CONFIRM, which are REFUTED or need weakening, and the exact site of each defect. Be specific and adversarial; a confirmation with no attempted refutation is not useful to me. Do not edit source files.
